S0910.reason: Only the Solutrean is defined by fine laurel-leaf stone blades, and the Magdalenian tradition that came after it is defined by bone and antler work.

S0390.reason: The hydrogen line appears at a shorter wavelength than the laboratory value, a blueshift produced by motion toward us.

S0606.reason: A mismatch between the earliest New World skulls and modern Native American skulls was taken to indicate descent from a different ancestral population.

S0851.reason: Spirit was in Mars’s southern hemisphere and was tilted north during southern winter so its solar panels faced the low sun.

S0460.reason: Equal prograde spin and orbital periods keep one hemisphere facing the sun, so Planet X has no solar day.
